warm.selection: first three games in immutable PGN; no result or position selection
warm.lifecycle: same searcher, TT, history, evaluator, and full game position from ply 23 through ply 48; NewGame between games

observer.mode: eager arithmetic retained; demand metadata only
observer.dependency_rule: an evaluation demands both current perspectives; pop propagates each demanded perspective to its parent except across that perspective's king refresh boundary
classifies: required and abandoned move/null accumulator-copy perspectives
required and abandoned update-2/update-3/update-4 perspective calls
observer.identity_gate: each baseline and observed fixed-node trajectory must match exactly in nodes, depth, seldepth, best move, score, and PV
integrity_gates: balanced evaluator depth after every search
legal best move and unchanged root

uncredited: update4 flat cost, except inside the optimistic residual
null accumulator-copy cost until separately isolated
transition derivation, position copying, output evaluation, and unrelated search work

decision_rule.below_threshold: shelve L1 and record a reopen condition
decision_rule.at_or_above_threshold: admit one exact lazy implementation to the separately frozen L1 parity and timing gate
